nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Land use planning|Land use mapping_qna_000
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How limited has spatial mapping and understanding of land use been across Nigeria?
nodes.answer: Spatial mapping and understanding of land use across Nigeria have been extremely limited, with only a few academic studies and two national land cover surveys conducted since 1976.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Land use planning|Land use mapping_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: Which methods were used in the study to analyze ecosystem services?
nodes.answer: The study utilized remote sensing images to produce land cover maps for 2009 and 2020 and mapped six ecosystem services using a lookup table approach.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Land use planning|Land use mapping_qna_002
nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What is the significance of mapping individual ecosystem services?
nodes.answer: Mapping individual ecosystem services helps to understand their distribution across the landscape, which is crucial for sustainable spatial planning.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Land use planning|Land use mapping_qna_003
nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What are the primary land uses in the Ile-de-France region?
nodes.answer: The primary land uses in the Ile-de-France region are urban areas (20%), agricultural land (53%), and forests (23%).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Land use planning|Land use mapping_qna_004
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What tool was used to identify the land cover at each study site?
nodes.answer: ArcGIS Pro (version 2.9) was used to identify the land cover at each study site by overlaying GPS locations with the Corine Land Cover map (2018).
